# Product Designer Portfolio Review

> An AI agent skill that reviews UX, UI and product design portfolios the way a busy hiring reviewer would. Paste a portfolio URL; get a scored report with evidence tags, red flags and at most five prioritised fixes. Informed by UXfolio’s State of UX Portfolios 2026. Scoring weights are this skill’s own. MIT licence.

This repository is a Bun monorepo: installable skill under `skills/pd-portfolio-review/`, landing site under `apps/web/`.

Install (Node.js 22+):

```
npx skills add leonardobetti/pd-portfolio-review@pd-portfolio-review
```

How to invoke after install: ask to review a portfolio and include the URL, or call `/pd-portfolio-review` (Claude Code / Cursor) or `$pd-portfolio-review` (Codex). Optional inputs: target role, site password.

## Skill (agents)

- [SKILL.md](skills/pd-portfolio-review/SKILL.md): Full skill instructions — fetch URL, reviewer path, fairness rules, scoring, report shape
- [Report template](skills/pd-portfolio-review/references/report-template.md): Required report sections and tone
- [UXfolio 2026 reference](skills/pd-portfolio-review/references/uxfolio-2026.md): Checks, red flags and cited figures by chapter
- [Evals README](skills/pd-portfolio-review/evals/README.md): How to run the 27 invented review cases
- [Eval cases](skills/pd-portfolio-review/evals/cases.json): Structured eval prompts and expected behaviours
